metrics_finding.finding: payment-service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization remained stable.

evidence_summary.summary: Payment service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization remained stable.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor payment service CPU utilization and adjust resource allocation as needed.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to an increase in CPU utilization of the payment service. Further investigation is required to confirm this finding.
report_text.hi: विवरण के आधार पर, घटना की मूल समस्या पेमेंट सेवा की सीपीयू लागत में वृद्धि होने के संभावित कारण से जुड़ी हो सकती है। औरर्निंग की आवश्यकता है इसकी पुष्टि करने के लिए.
